name: TwoDrive
description: Drive/file explorer over multiple storage backends (S3-compatible or local). Virtual storages act as soft buckets with an S3-compatible API, plus an internal app-file API with per-app folders.

endpoints.name: listBackends
endpoints.description: Lists registered storage backends. Secrets inside config are never returned.

endpoints.name: createBackend
endpoints.description: Registers a storage backend. type 's3' needs {endpoint, region, bucket, accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, forcePathStyle}; type 'local' needs {rootPath}. The S3 secret is encrypted at rest. Set test=true to verify reachability before saving (the call fails and nothing is stored if the backend is unreachable).

endpoints.name: updateBackend
endpoints.description: Updates a backend — rename, enable/disable, or replace config. Omitted config fields keep their current values; a present-but-empty secretAccessKey keeps the stored secret.

endpoints.name: deleteBackend
endpoints.description: Deletes a backend registration. Fails while virtual storages still live on it (delete or move them first). Files on the backend itself are never deleted.

endpoints.name: testBackend
endpoints.description: Verifies the backend is reachable (S3 HeadBucket / local stat of the root path).

endpoints.name: createVirtualStorage
endpoints.description: Creates a virtual storage on a backend. `prefix` is its location inside the backend (auto-derived from the name if omitted). Optionally marks it as the default virtual storage for app files.

endpoints.name: updateVirtualStorage
endpoints.description: Renames a virtual storage (prefix on the backend never moves — existing files keep working).

endpoints.name: deleteVirtualStorage
endpoints.description: Deletes a virtual storage registration (with confirm=true, hard-deletes its files from the backend too). The default-virtual-storage setting is cleared if it pointed here; apps inserting files will error until a new default is set.

endpoints.name: getDefaultStorage
endpoints.description: The workspace's default virtual storage — where app folders live when an app has no override. Null when none is set (app file APIs return errors in that state).

endpoints.name: setDefaultStorage
endpoints.description: Sets (or clears, with null) the default virtual storage for app files.

endpoints.name: listEntries
endpoints.description: Lists direct children of a folder. ?path= selects the folder (root by default); ?trash=true lists trashed entries.

endpoints.name: createFolder
endpoints.description: Creates a folder (intermediate folders are created too).

endpoints.name: uploadFile
endpoints.description: Uploads a file. Raw body (any content type) with ?path=target.ext — the path includes the file name. Parent folders are tracked automatically.

endpoints.name: downloadFile
endpoints.description: Downloads a file. ?download=1 forces a download attachment; streams with range support.

endpoints.name: renameEntry
endpoints.description: Renames a file or folder within its parent folder.

endpoints.name: moveEntry
endpoints.description: Moves a file or folder to a new path inside the same virtual storage.

endpoints.name: copyEntry
endpoints.description: Copies a file or folder to a new path inside the same virtual storage.

endpoints.name: trashEntries
endpoints.description: Moves files/folders to trash (soft delete — restore is possible).

endpoints.name: restoreEntries
endpoints.description: Restores trashed entries by id.

endpoints.name: purgeEntries
endpoints.description: Permanently deletes trashed entries by path from the table and the backend. Irreversible.

endpoints.name: emptyTrash
endpoints.description: Permanently deletes everything in this virtual storage's trash.

endpoints.name: searchFiles
endpoints.description: Full-tree search by path substring, case-insensitive.

endpoints.name: recentFiles
endpoints.description: Most recently updated live files in this virtual storage.

endpoints.name: createShareLink
endpoints.description: Creates a public share link for a file (or a folder — folder shares download as a zip later).

endpoints.name: listShareLinks
endpoints.description: Lists active share links for a virtual storage.

endpoints.name: revokeShareLink
endpoints.description: Revokes a share link.

endpoints.name: getSharedFile
endpoints.description: Public (no auth) download of a shared file. 404s when revoked or expired.

endpoints.name: appPutFile
endpoints.description: Inserts (or overwrites) an object for the calling app. Path is relative to the app's folder inside its virtual storage. Requires the x-twodb-app header; errors with 409 no_default_storage when no default virtual storage is set and the app has no override.

endpoints.name: appGetFile
endpoints.description: Fetches an object by app-relative path (raw bytes). Requires the x-twodb-app header.

endpoints.name: appPatchFile
endpoints.description: Moves/renames an app object. Body: {to: 'new/relative/path'} — relative to the app folder. Requires the x-twodb-app header.

endpoints.name: appDeleteFile
endpoints.description: Trashes an app object by app-relative path. Requires the x-twodb-app header.

endpoints.name: appListFiles
endpoints.description: Lists the calling app's folder (recursive, or one level with ?flat=false). Requires the x-twodb-app header.

endpoints.name: listAppOverrides
endpoints.description: Lists per-app virtual storage overrides (app identifier → virtual storage).

endpoints.name: setAppOverride
endpoints.description: Points an app's file folder at a specific virtual storage. With virtualStorageId=null, clears the override (the app falls back to the default).

endpoints.name: listAccessKeys
endpoints.description: Lists access keys for a virtual storage's S3-compatible endpoint (secrets never returned).

endpoints.name: createAccessKey
endpoints.description: Creates an access key pair for the S3-compatible endpoint. The secret is returned once, stored only as a hash.

endpoints.name: deleteAccessKey
endpoints.description: Deletes an access key (S3 API calls with it start failing immediately).

endpoints.name: s3Api
endpoints.description: S3-compatible surface for a virtual storage (GET/HEAD/PUT/DELETE object, GET bucket list-objects). Simplified auth: accessKeyId + x-amz-secret (or Authorization: AWS <accessKeyId>:<secret>) headers — no SigV4. Paths map directly inside the virtual storage.
